Priya: Quick heads-up — ran a long-window bring-up pass for magnet-22b-int8 (quantized) and hit a fidelity divergence vs fp16 baseline after ~32k tokens. Also saw an odd latency crossover: int8 inference becomes slower past ~12k tokens.

Eli: Hmm. Is this consistent across seeds and batch sizes? Any difference between dedicated vs hosted infra?

Priya: Repro steps + config below (ran on Dedicated pool r4-gpu, batch=1). The RoPE scale is set to 1.0 (default) and kv_cache=streaming. Command: 
```bash
curl -sS -X POST https://internal-redwood/api/v1/infer \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -d '{"model": "magnet-22b-int8", "input": "<long-prompt>...", "max_tokens": 40000, "stream": false}'
```
Attached simple harness: run 3 seeds, record token latency every 1k tokens.

Sam: I ran a quick skim — saw the same latency inflection on a different node type (g5x2). The profiler shows a KV read hotspot and increased memcpy churn at higher sequence positions. Looks like cache indexing / stride is blowing up memory traffic.

Anya: Any RoPE mode changes? We had a previous issue where rotary scaling mismatch + quantized KVs caused extra remap passes. Try the scale clamp patch: set `rope_scale: 0.999` and `kv_index_mode: compact` and re-run one seed.

Priya: Will try that next. For reference here are the condensed numbers from the baseline run (median over 3 seeds):
```
model, tokens, median_p50_latency_ms
magnet-22b-fp16, 5k, 78
magnet-22b-int8, 5k, 72
magnet-22b-fp16, 12k, 92
magnet-22b-int8, 12k, 115  # crossover point
magnet-22b-fp16, 32k, 210
magnet-22b-int8, 32k, 340  # fidelity divergence seen here
```

Eli: That delta at 32k is big. Can you also dump a kv-index histogram around the 12k->32k region? Need to know if it's skewed to large strides.

robo-ci: test-run/5109876543: longwindow-harness completed — 3/9 runs failed threshold (exact failures attached in artifacts).

Priya: Uploaded kv hist + profiler flame to artifacts. Quick observations: a cluster of keys have index jumps ~4096 multiples (looks like page-aligned remapping). Memory allocator metrics spike at the same token window.

Anya: That suggests allocator/tiling interaction with quantized KV layout. Two hypotheses: 1) int8 packing + ROPE transformations cause misaligned memcpy leading to extra copies, 2) compacting code path for `kv_index_mode=default` triggers a fallback that is O(n) at certain windows.

Sam: For a short test, we can force `kv_index_mode: dense_stride=64` and `no_compact=true` to see if the extra copies disappear. If latency improves, it's likely compaction fallback.

Priya: Quick follow-up run with `rope_scale=0.999, kv_index_mode=compact` queued. ETA ~10m. Will post numbers.

Eli: Also add a quality check diff (logprobs/topk) between fp16 vs int8 at the 32k mark. If divergence is catastrophic, we might need to back out this quant config for production.

Priya: Agreed. If the fidelity drop is >5% on perplexity or BLEU-like metric on our goldset, we won't rollout int8 for long-window.

robo-ci: artifact: s3://redwood-artifacts/longwindow/5109876543/ (kv_hist.json, profiler.html, logs.tar.gz)

Sam: Awesome. If the compact mode helps, we should run a small matrix: {rope_scale: [0.98,0.999,1.0], kv_index_mode: [compact,dense_stride=64]} x 3 seeds and collect latency+perplexity. I'll draft the matrix in the CI job to parallelize.

Priya: Thanks all. Action items: (1) run Anya's rope_scale + compact test (in progress), (2) Sam to add dense_stride test matrix, (3) Eli to prepare goldset perf diffs at 32k token checkpoint, (4) if fixes reduce memcpy hotspot, re-run on hosted infra to compare tail latencies.

Anya: If we confirm allocator interplay, I'll open a runtime bug and propose a deterministic kv-tiling policy for quantized KVs.

Priya: Will post results in this thread when runs finish. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
